name: spawn-children
description: Named for a job whose run_command tool would fork background children (docs/04 #10's whole-process-group-kill guarantee). The fake binary never actually executes CommandLine — it only fabricates tool_info (see test/fake-agy/agy.mjs) — so it cannot itself spawn real OS descendants; agy.mjs is out of this scope's write access to change that. This scenario stands in for that case with the same long single-process sleep as 'hang', so agy_cancel / timeout tests can still assert the fake agy process's own group is empty afterwards (pgrep -g <pgid>). A real descendant-tree test would need agy.mjs itself to spawn a child for this step, which is a source change outside test/fake-agy/scenarios/**.
